description: Contextual extra-high-density residential district. Quality Housing with enhanced bulk. Floor area ratio 9.0. Produces tall bulky 16-18 story buildings. R9X equivalent to C1-8X and C2-7X overlays.

bulk.far_note: UAP standard. R9X is highest non-R10 contextual district. Community facility FAR per ZR §24-11.

height_setback.notes: Per ZR §23-432 table (R9X1, R9X2 rows). Tall buildings: R9X1 min base 105 ft; R9X2 min base 60 ft. Max building height 175 ft (R9X1) and 165 ft (R9X2) standard. Qualifying extends to 215 ft.

side.requirement: Per §23-335: none required for Quality Housing contextual

rear.through_lot_alternative: Rear yard equivalent per §23-343 on through lots ≥180 ft

dob_filing_notes: R9X (FAR 9.0) is very high density — verify district vs R9A vs R9D
16-18 story buildings typical — structural coordination required in DOB filing
